analysis.title: US Watch: October PCE inflation tracking: A third straight 0.3% m/m print
key_insights: After incorporating the October CPI data, BofA is tracking 0.32% m/m for core PCE, up from its initial estimate of 0.23% m/m.
The tracking estimate would lift the core PCE y/y rate to 3.3% from 3.1%, which BofA calls a clearly hawkish development.
BofA is tracking headline PCE at 0.34% m/m and 3.9% y/y.
The CPI data topped BofA's expectations, driven in part by broad-based strength in goods inflation. BofA says this could be evidence of energy and AI related input cost pass through.

The core PCE tracking estimate would meet Governor Waller's threshold for a 50bp hike in December, based on his remarks the morning of the report. BofA says this helps explain the move in market pricing.
BofA still expects the Fed to raise 25bp for now, but says the door to a larger hike at the next meeting has opened further after the data.
